title: Monster Designer
subtitle: Slicing and stitching, new scratches, and old sores—my flawless creations.

items.text: A Nightmare at Green Lake

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The lighthouse is sinking. Everyone, move and leave now!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Anne ... She ...

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: She was The Last Girl. She was our only means to survive in this horror story, and we have lost her.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: No. She was never with us.
Blonney murmurs, staggering slowly.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: I'm to blame. It's me who created such a girl at Green Lake, a girl who restrains people and treats them like toys!

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Calm down, Blonney, calm down.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: I ... I can't.
She almost bursts into tears.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: It's too late, Tooth Fairy. We have lost all the cards!

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: We still have a chance.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: You don't understand. It was me who created the stories. I created that monster!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: I've drawn many monsters in that notebook. With all those stories I told, I created her!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: I turned our Last Girl into the biggest villain. What should we do now? How are we gonna ...

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: You are right. This is the story created by you.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: They are all created by you. It's your story, your monsters, your past, your arcanum, and your identity as an arcanist.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: They all belong to you.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Belong ... to me?
The ground shakes again. The critters are crashing against the glass window irritably.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: The monster born in the bottom of the lake, the butcher, and the pathetic bride—they all came from you.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: It was you who taught Jessica how to make a story, how to create all of this. She created them all, but you endowed her with such ability. She's the creator of these, and you are the creator of the creator.
Everything in their sight is shaking and even collapsing.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: This is a page in your chapter. You created it, so you should learn to accept it, control it, not fear it.
Tooth Fairy is still walking forward determinedly, step by step.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Don't run away, but face it.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Blonney ... Timekeeper ...
Sonetto struggles, but it doesn't stop her from sinking.
She gradually loses her strength due to the lack of oxygen. Then, she seems to see a spot of silver light flashing on the bottom of the dark lake.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: A boat? Is this Blonney's …

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: It's her arcanum. Now, she is doing her utmost to keep the ship in balance.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Damn it. I knew I shouldn't be so ostentatious. There's no way that I can have control over such a big boat!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: If I keep doing this for any longer, I would die of a headache before making it to An ... Jessica!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: I've warned you so, haven't I?

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: But don't worry. The reliable Horropedia will save your neck.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Using this amazing tool.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Good, hooked onto the rock!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: You might feel a bit seasick. Please try not to vomit. If you fail, at least don't puke on me!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Sit still and hold tight. We are heading towards the river bank!
As they move forward, the river bank extends from a point to a line. In the blink of an eye, they have reached the bank.
The critters guarding the bank are roaring together.
